title: PPARβ/δ ligand response in monocyte derived macrophages
description: The PPARD ligand response (agonist and inverse agonist) in monocyte derived macrophages from 3 healthy donors was assesed via RNAseq.

samples.title: AN006
samples.description: Protocols: Cells were isolated on June 06th 2013 from healthy human donor blood of unknown gender via LSM1077 gradient centrifugation. Adherent cells were positivly selected on primaria 6 well dishes (3x10^6 monocytes per well in 2 ml PBS (PAA)) followed by 6 washing steps with PBS. Finally the monocytes were cultured for 6d in humidified incubator at 37 °C, 5 % CO2 in 2ml RPMI medium supplemented with 10 % FCS (both PAA). Cells were treated with control (DMSO), L165 1 µM final concentration or PTS-264 1 µM final concentration for 1d. Cells were lysed in Peqgold (TRIzol-like solution based on phenol and chloroform). RNA was digested with DNase (MN) and purified on a Qiagen Minelute column. Illumina-compatible libraries were made using the Epicentre Scriptseq human/mouse/rat low input Gold kit.

runs.experiment_title: Illumina HiSeq 1500 sequencing: PPARβ/δ ligand response in monocyte derived macrophages
